stem:
The graph shows Esha's snack stall sales on Sports Day. The vertical scale uses equal intervals.

Which snack sold the most?

options.text: Juice, because its bar is tallest on the equal-interval scale.
Samosa, because the snack name alone settles the sales value.
Fruit, as if equal intervals on the vertical scale are not required.
Juice, because darker shading settles the sales value.

teacher.key_rationale: Bar height on the equal-interval vertical scale encodes sales; Juice is tallest at 7. A snack name alone or shading does not encode the value, and dropping equal intervals breaks the reading rule.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote pie chart source into a three-bar sales graph; stem refers to the graph.
